senses.gloss: m. (στατίων, statio, v. Harper’s Lat. Dict. 1882 s. v. Statio II, B, 4) seat of the fiscal officers in the Roman provinces, also the staff of officers.
units: Gen. R. s. 66 (play on Shulamith Cant. VII,

senses.gloss: the people of Israel <he>שמשלמת אִיסְטַטְיוֹנוֹ של עולם וכ׳</he> that preserves the (divine) government of the world complete (filling the vacancies) both in this world &c. Cant. R. to l. c. <cite ref="A01430"><he>איסטטיונרון</he></cite>, read <he>אִיסְטַטְיוֹנָרִין</he> (stationarii) the number of officers (of the divine government). Cmp. <he>צַדִּיק</he>.
